notes: Mashups: games played inside other games. SkyCraft puts a Minecraft player into Skyrim, and Skate Warfare joins MW2, Skate 3 and a Minecraft world.

Mash up any two of your games: Fenrir sets up the project, and its builder builds it with the AI you choose: LM Studio's models on your PC, Ollama, or OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI or Gemini with your own key.
Every game gets a plugin slot: Fenrir reads what each game is made with and offers the loader that fits.
